title: Cloud Automation Engineer
description:
Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Automation Engineer to design, implement, and maintain scalable automation solutions across cloud and containerized environments. The candidate will be responsible for infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipeline development, container orchestration, and deployment automation, ensuring reliability, security, scalability, and operational efficiency. The role involves close collaboration with development, QA, security, and infrastructure teams to improve automation capabilities and streamline software delivery.

Responsibilities:

* Design, develop, and maintain cloud infrastructure automation using Terraform and Ansible.
* Design, implement, and manage Docker containers and Kubernetes-based deployment environments.
* Develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Maven, and related tools.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment activities.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts using Bash/Shell, Python, Groovy, or other scripting languages.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, builds, deployments, and containerized environments.
* Support cloud infrastructure provisioning and automation across AWS and/or Azure environments.
* Collaborate with development, QA, security, and operations teams to improve deployment processes and automation practices.
* Implement DevOps best practices related to infrastructure as code, version control, security, scalability, and reliability.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, and enhance deployment automation.

Qualifications:

* + 4+ years of relevant experience in Cloud, DevOps, Infrastructure Automation, or related technologies.
  + Strong hands-on experience designing, implementing, and maintaining Docker and Kubernetes environments.
  + Practical experience with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  + Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, and Maven.
  + Hands-on experience with Ansible for infrastructure and configuration automation.
  + Strong scripting skills in one or more of the following: Bash/Shell, Python, or Groovy.
  + Good understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD concepts, version control, and automated deployment processes.
  + Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across infrastructure, build, deployment, and container environments.

  **Education Qualification**

  + Engineering degree or Master's degree in IT / Application Development or a related technical discipline.

  **Good to Have**

  + Knowledge of AWS and/or Microsoft Azure cloud services and architecture.
  + Hands-on experience with cloud services such as compute, storage, networking, IAM, monitoring, and container services.
  + Good understanding of Linux system administration, including configuration, troubleshooting, networking, and performance monitoring.
  + Knowledge of cloud security principles and infrastructure security best practices.
  + Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments.
  + Exposure to monitoring, logging, and infrastructure observability tools.

  **Preferred Technical Skills**

Company Overview:

**Company Overview**

Axway has been shaping the future of enterprise integration for over 25 years. We are recognized as global industry leaders, helping organizations drive digital transformation with secure, mission-critical software that powers impactful business outcomes.

As part of **74Software**, we’re backed by a group of leading software companies delivering mission-critical solutions worldwide. Our focus is on delivering long-term value, leveraging cutting-edge technology, and fostering strong client partnerships. Join us and be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team shaping the future of enterprise integration solutions.

**Why Axway?**

At Axway, we believe we’re better together. We celebrate diverse perspectives and experiences, knowing our people are our greatest strength. Join us and be part of a team where you can thrive, grow, and make an impact.

We offer benefits that support your health, growth, and lifestyle, so you can thrive at work and beyond, including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, flexible work, career development, competitive pay, and global culture perks.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

We are committed to providing equal opportunities and ensuring a fair and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, race, religion, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Applied AI & Automation Engineer
description:
Join Aristocrat Gaming’s AI Products & Enablement team as an Applied AI & Automation Engineer and be part of a world-class company leading gaming innovation. At Aristocrat, we value the power of play and are committed to bringing happiness to life through our innovative products and solutions. This role offers an outstanding chance to work with top experts in the field and contribute to pioneering AI and automation projects. If you are ambitious, motivated, and eager to make a meaningful impact, this is the right place for you.

**What You'll Do:-**

  

* Build and configure AI agents, skills, prompts, and automation workflows to defined requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Develop integrations and data connections to enterprise systems under the direction of the Lead AI Solution Architect.
* Write and run tests and evaluations to confirm accuracy, reliability, and safe behavior before release.
* Implement telemetry that tracks quality, cost, exceptions, and human overrides for each product.
* Create and maintain reusable components and templates that business builders and other engineers can apply.
* Document solutions, configurations, and runbooks, and support releases in partnership with Group IT.
* Participate in Scrum ceremonies and contribute estimates, demos, and improvement ideas.

**What We're Looking For:-**

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related field.
* 3+ years of software development or automation experience, including hands-on work with generative AI or LLM-based solutions..
* Experience with at least one of Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Salesforce Flow or Agentforce, or similar AI and automation platforms.
* Familiarity with testing practices and version control (Github).
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and clear written English communication.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*

**Compensation Philosophy**
===========================

We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.

Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.

Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: Senior SDET
description:
We are seeking a **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** with strong hands-on experience in **testing AI/ML-driven applications**, preferably within the **medical or healthcare domain**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing robust test frameworks, validating AI outputs, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining high quality standards for mission-critical healthcare solutions.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain **automated test frameworks** for AI-driven and data-intensive applications
* Validate **AI/ML models**, including:
* Input data quality
* Model outputs
* Accuracy, consistency, bias, and edge cases
* Perform **functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing** for AI tools used in medical workflows
* Collaborate with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Developers, and Product teams to define **test strategies for AI features**
* Test **model retraining cycles**, versioning, and backward compatibility
* Ensure compliance with **healthcare regulations and standards** (HIPAA, FDA guidelines, HL7, FHIR – as applicable)
* Implement **API, backend, and UI automation testing**
* Perform **data validation testing** for large datasets and pipelines
* Conduct **performance, scalability, security, and reliability testing** for AI systems
* Participate in code reviews, test planning, defect triaging, and CI/CD pipeline integration
* Provide mentorship and guidance to junior QA/SDET team members

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience as an **SDET / QA Automation Engineer**
* Strong hands-on experience in **test automation** using tools such as:
* Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar
* Proficiency in at least one programming language:
* Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript
* Solid experience in **testing AI/ML-based applications**, including:
* Model validation
* Data-driven testing
* Explainability and accuracy checks
* Experience testing **RESTful APIs** (Postman, RestAssured, etc.)
* Strong understanding of **software testing fundamentals** and QA best practices
* Experience with **CI/CD pipelines** (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.)
* Hands-on experience with **test data management and data validation**
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong communication skills for working with **global and cross-functional teams**

  

**Good to Have:**

* Experience in **medical / healthcare domain** projects
* Familiarity with **AI/ML concepts** (model training, inference, drift, bias)
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards such as **HL7, FHIR, DICOM**
* Experience testing **LLM-based tools**, NLP, computer vision, or decision-support systems
* Exposure to **cloud platforms** (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Understanding of **regulatory and compliance testing** in healthcare products

**About Us:**

TechAhead is **a global digital transformation company** with a strong presence in the USA and India. We specialize in **AI-first product design thinking and bespoke development solutions**. With over 15 years of proven expertise, we have partnered with **Fortune 500 companies and leading global brands** to drive digital innovation and deliver excellence. At TechAhead, we are committed to **continuous learning, growth and crafting tailored solutions** that meet the unique needs of our clients.

Join us to shape the future of digital innovation worldwide and drive impactful results with cutting-edge AI tools and strategies!

title: GTM / AI Automation Engineer
description:
***Role Overview***

The selected candidate will design, build, test, and maintain AI automation workflows for sales, marketing, lead generation, recruitment, and business operations. This is a hands-on technical role requiring practical problem-solving skills, an understanding of AI agents, and the ability to convert business requirements into working automation systems.

***Key Responsibilities***

1. AI Workflow Automation

· Build and maintain automation workflows using n8n, Make, or Zapier.

· Connect applications and services to automate repetitive business tasks.

· Configure triggers, conditions, loops, data transformations, and error handling.

· Test and troubleshoot workflows to ensure reliable execution.

2. AI Agent Development

· Build AI-powered agents using Claude API, OpenAI API, and other LLM tools.

· Create prompt-based workflows, structured outputs, and tool-calling integrations.

· Develop AI workflows for lead research, qualification, content assistance, data extraction, and reporting.

· Implement human approval steps for sensitive or high-impact automated actions.

· Test AI-generated outputs for accuracy and consistency.

3. API Integration and Development

· Integrate third-party applications using REST APIs and webhooks.

· Work with JSON, API authentication, OAuth, and data mapping.

· Use Python or JavaScript for custom automation logic.

· Connect CRM platforms, databases, communication tools, and business applications.

· Debug API errors, authentication issues, and workflow failures.

4. GTM and Sales Automation

· Build automated workflows for B2B lead generation and qualification.

· Integrate tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, and approved prospecting platforms.

· Automate lead enrichment, CRM updates, follow-up tasks, and sales reporting.

· Support AI-powered account research and personalized outreach workflows.

· Maintain data quality and follow applicable privacy and communication requirements.

5. Testing and Maintenance

· Monitor workflow execution and resolve errors.

· Maintain documentation for workflows, integrations, and technical configurations.

· Optimize automation performance, API usage, and execution costs.

· Follow secure credential-management practices.

· Collaborate with team members to deliver projects on time.

***Required Technical Skills***

· 1–3 years of experience in workflow automation, software development, API integrations, or AI automation.

· Practical knowledge of n8n, Make, or Zapier.

· Experience using Claude API, OpenAI API, or similar LLM services.

· Basic to intermediate Python or JavaScript.

· Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and authentication.

· Knowledge of prompt engineering and AI workflow design.

· Strong debugging, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

***Good-to-have skills***

· Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho CRM.

· Familiarity with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and AI agent frameworks.

· Experience with PostgreSQL, Google Sheets, Slack, or Google Workspace integrations.

· Knowledge of Docker, cloud platforms, and workflow monitoring.

· Understanding of sales, marketing, and business process automation.

***Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)***

· Successful development and deployment of assigned automation workflows.

· Accuracy and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

· Reduction in repetitive manual tasks.

· Timely completion of development tasks.

· Number and quality of successfully deployed integrations.

· Reduction in workflow errors and recurring failures.

· Quality of documentation and troubleshooting.

Pay: ₹325,000.00 - ₹720,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Work from home

Work Location: In person
